monument_name: Bhurtī Śikhara Temples with Pavilion (ca. 14th-15th cent.)
name_devanagari: भुर्ती शिखर मन्दिरहरू र मण्डप || DLK0015
description_en: Two śikhara temples with a central pavilion from approximately 14th-15th century.The monuments are found in the southern part of the Bhurtī Temple Complex. The site itself is located in the northern end of the settlement of Bhurtī, 3 km north of Narayana, the district headquarters. It currently comprises 22 standingśikharatemples (ordevala) and one stone fountain. Architectural activity at the site can be situated between the 13thand 15thcentury, a time period corresponding to the latter part of the Khaśa Malla empire and the early phase of the Rāskoṭi dynasty (Andolfatto 2019,Pokharel 2011: 128-129,Sharma 1972: 23-31,Sharma 2012: 120-123).In 2008, the “Bhurti Temple Complex of Dailekh” was enlisted on UNESCO’s World Heritage Tentative List by the Government of Nepal (criteriaiiandiv).The monuments consist in twośikharasfacing each other. The space between the two monuments is occupied by a pavilion (maṇḍapa,baiṭhak). This type of architecture is not met anywhere else in the Karnali Basin but is found in Ajayamerukoṭa, in Dadeldhura district. There are nevertheless structural differences between the Bhurtī and Ajayamerukoṭa monuments: in Bhurtī the pavilion was built as a planned constituent of the temples, while in Ajayamerukoṭa the pavilion appears as an independant structure. This would indicate that the architects at work in Bhurtī were inspired by pre-existing models, such as the Ajayamerukoṭa monuments (themselves modelled on temples from Uttarakhand). Given the fact that the Ajayamerukoṭa monuments are dated from 1373 CE (ŚS 1295), the Bhurtī monuments must post-date it and can therefore be dated around the end of the 14th century and the 15th century (Andolfatto 2019: 88).
description_ne: भुर्ती मन्दिर पसिरमा २२ शिखर मन्दिरहरू र एउटा ढुङ्गे धारा छन् । सन् २००८ मा यो मन्दिर परिसरलाई नेपाल सरकारले UNESCO’s World Heritage को ‘tentative list’ मा सूचीकृत गरेको थियो । यहाँ प्रस्तुत दुई शिखर मन्दिरहरू र एउटा मण्डप/बैठक भुर्ती मन्दिर परिसरको दक्षिणतर्फको भागमा अवस्थित छन् । यी सम्पदाहरू ईशाको चौधौंदेखि पन्ध्रौं शताब्दीमा निर्माण गरिएका हुनुपर्दछ (हेर्नुहोस् Andolfatto 2019: 88) । यी दुई शिखर मन्दिरहरू एक-अर्कातर्फ फर्केर रहेका छन् र मन्दिरहरूको मध्य खुल्ला भागमा भने एउटा मण्डप/वैठक छ । यस्ता प्रकारका सम्पदा कर्णाली वरिपरि कतै पनि फेला परेका छैनन् तर अजयमेरुकोटमा भने यस्तै बनावटका सम्पदाहरू भेटिन्छन् तर भुर्ती शिखर मन्दिरहरू र अजयमेरूकोटमा भएका यस्ता सम्पदाहरु बिच केहि मात्रामा संरचानगत भिन्नता भने स्पष्ट देखिन्छ । उदाहरणको लागि भुर्तिमा भएको मण्डप/बैठक मन्दिर संरचानाकै एक अंङ्गको रूपमा रहेको देखिन्छ भने अजयमेरुकोटमा रहेको बैठक/मण्डप एउटा छुट्टै संरचनाको रुपमा रहेको देखिन्छ ।
monument_assessment: Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired)
